treatment_area: Female Students from Government Higher Secondary Schools in Tamil Nadu
comparison_area: Female Students from Private Unaided Higher Secondary Schools in Tamil Nadu
comparability_assessment: Treatment cohort has substantially lower baseline socioeconomic status; private cohort serves as descriptive reference group rather than strict counterfactual.
causal_assumptions: Parallel trends assumption requires that in the absence of Pudhumai Penn, government school girls college transition would have followed the same trajectory as private school girls.
confounding_factors: Concurrent post-COVID educational reopening, free bus travel for women (Zero Ticket Bus scheme), and expansion of government arts & science colleges.
analysis_method: Observational difference-in-differences on administrative EMIS cohort data without randomized control.
limitations: Cannot prove strict causation due to concurrent welfare policies and non-parallel baseline socioeconomic status of cohorts.

treatment_area: Government Primary Schools (Classes 1-5, Beneficiaries of CM Breakfast Scheme)
comparison_area: Upper Primary Classes in Same Schools (Classes 6-8, Non-Beneficiaries)
comparability_assessment: Co-located students in same school infrastructure controlling for local geography and weather shocks; age and maturity differences present.
causal_assumptions: Assumes attendance shocks in primary classes would equal upper primary classes absent the morning breakfast intervention.
confounding_factors: Implementation of Ennum Ezhuthum foundational literacy mission in Classes 1-3 creating interactive pedagogy incentives.
analysis_method: Within-school comparative cohort difference using daily EMIS attendance records.
limitations: Within-school sibling spillovers cannot be ruled out; unmeasured teacher attention shifts may contribute to attendance gains.

treatment_area: Rural Primary Health Blocks in Krishnagiri District (Pilot Region)
comparability_assessment: Krishnagiri was chosen deliberately as the pilot region due to high rurality and established community volunteer networks.
causal_assumptions: Assumes pilot region screening velocity would mirror state average in the absence of intensive early administrative deployment.
confounding_factors: Intensive administrative supervision and early digital tablet provisioning in the Chief Minister launch district.
analysis_method: Longitudinal administrative tracking of screening density per 1,000 adult population.
limitations: Hawthorne effect in high-visibility launch district limits generalizability to routine statewide operations.
